changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Idempotency key of the series creation: a repeated request after a timeout finds the series already created instead of making a second one.

changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: The key is unique inside the tenant schema: two concurrent requests with the same key cannot both create a series.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_calendar_event_series_idempotency_key ON calendar_event_series (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL;
